setup_translation_self_task: setup a TranslationSelfTask by calling setup_task with parsed args to load source and target dictionaries
add_translation_self_args: add translation self task arguments to an argparse parser including source lang, target lang, and mask range
load_translation_dataset: load a train, valid, or test dataset split for the translation self task with dynamic length masking
get_max_positions: get the max source and target positions allowed by the translation self task
review_TranslationSelfTask: review the TranslationSelfTask class and its load_dataset method for self-supervised translation with mask range support
